steps.path: An admin command asks for approval
steps.headline: The admin prompt gains an Always allow choice.
steps.changed: Run it and Deny stay unchanged. Always allow opens the scope picker without approving anything.
steps.notice: The existing approval card stays familiar; no other permission prompts change. References: the current admin card, command approval card, and Settings → Permissions.
steps.risk: This is the UI review only; saved and session allowances will be connected after approval.

steps.headline: Choose this command, all in Full Auto, or all for this session.
steps.changed: Only this command starts selected. Always allow in Full Auto is saved across projects and future sessions; Allow all for this session works in any permission mode and expires when the session closes.
steps.notice: Both broader choices cover passwordless admin commands only. Password entry still prompts when needed. Back changes nothing; Confirm and run approves the selected scope.
steps.risk: The broader scopes remove repeated approval checks for powerful commands. Their enforcement is not connected in this UI preview.

steps.headline: All three choices remain readable at phone width.
steps.changed: The same controls and explanations wrap within the existing chat card.
steps.notice: Nothing is hidden on a narrow screen. The theme supplies colors and button shapes.
steps.risk: The explanations make the card taller on a phone.
